texts.zh: 我们接见了[Root.GetName]上的一名[Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower]外星人代表。看上去他们的帝国最近遇到了困难时期，而且它们正在受到饥馑的威胁。它们恳求我们提供一切可以提供的援助。
texts.en: We have been approached by a delegation from the [Root.Owner.GetSubMantleLower] aliens on [Root.GetName]. It seems their empire has fallen on hard times recently, and they are facing the threat of a famine. They are pleading with us to provide whatever assistance we can.

label.en: Of course. We will help however we can.
They'll have to fend for themselves.
